source_note: WRITTEN FOR BANK v4 ON 2026-09-22. Forty NEW English story templates in the SHAPE the wild rows have and the signed bank did not: a list of three same-kind quantities from which the QUESTION selects two, the same owner measured at another time as the third quantity, and the addition and multiplication frames the bank never carried. NO wild row (from any collected or published word-problem set) was read, copied, paraphrased or used as a template here; every scene, every entity and every wording below was invented for this file, and the only thing borrowed from the wild data is the STRUCTURE described in the 2026-09-22 16:0x diagnosis (three same-kind numerals, a question that names two of them, mixed operators). Same schema as verified/<code>.verified.json plus three fields the v4 generator reads: `extra_slots` (the {T} third quantity), `op` (subtraction / addition / product) and `wild_shape` (which of the four shapes this is).
